scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build && node scripts/copy-release-notices.mjs
scripts.build:maintenance: npm run typecheck && vite build --mode maintenance && node scripts/copy-release-notices.mjs && node scripts/mark-maintenance-build.mjs
scripts.firefox:run: npm run build && web-ext run --source-dir dist --start-url https://www.nlb.gov.sg/seatbooking/
scripts.package:firefox: npm run build && node scripts/lint-firefox.mjs && web-ext build --source-dir dist --artifacts-dir . --filename nlb-seat-helper-firefox.zip --overwrite-dest
